info.title: Notient note API
info.description: Exact vault-relative Markdown paths; revisions are SHA-256 of UTF-8 file content; source offsets are UTF-16 code units. Scope filters intersect. Loopback only. Credentials are issued through notient pair create and never sent as query parameters.

port.description: Use the endpoint printed by notient pair create.
